title: Hiding in plain sight
caption:
Collectors gathered this tree-growing fern in Myanmar and Vietnam as early as the 19th century, but it was repeatedly identified as a different species. Fieldwork in the mountains of southern China, along with a closer look at its spore clusters and DNA, helped researchers distinguish Drynaria lineatisora. Its unusually long, narrow spore clusters were one clue.

Source: Phys.org · 27 Nov 2026
